name: Supliful
description: Private-label CPG dropshipping for creators — supplements, coffee, skincare, pet products — with product selection, e-commerce enablement, and fulfillment in one platform; no inventory to manage (company-stated). Founded Jun 2017, US. Founder Martins Lasmanis. Free to design; selling from $69/mo ($55/mo annual). ~1.6M estimated users (founder-stated). Domain: supliful.com, DR 71.

mentions.evidence: ~$179,949 MRR (−1.5% L30), 3,341 active subscriptions, ~$990,628 L30 (−0.7%; snapshot ~$991,205), ~$2,964,734 last 3 months, ~$5,972,387 last 6 months, ~$11,526,994 last 12 months, ~$53,654,567 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 10, 2026 ~05:47 Warsaw (03:47 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Don't compete on US supplements. Build a narrow EU private-label lane (PL/DE food supplements or pet treats) with one 3PL, Shopify + Stripe Tax, and a €79/mo "brand + fulfillment" seat for indie creators who already have an audience.

whyItPrints: This is fulfillment + white-label ops packaged as SaaS. L30 cash (~$991k) ≫ MRR (~$180k) because they also charge when end-customers buy products (platform take / product revenue flowing through Stripe — my inference from founder description "We charge customers at the time they make the purchase"). Nine figures all-time on TrustMRR. Boring physical-goods glue with software margins on the SaaS layer.
